$Comment: The Gravekeeper on a full moon outside Hallow's Eve, on the same spot near Old Jack in the
Forgotten Temple that his Hallow's Eve placement uses (Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Temple.json).
Pressing F opens his full moon conversation
(Dialogues/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Restless.json), which greets the player and says
who he is; it opens no graveyard. The temple stays peaceful.
Season makes him a guest: Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Moon is live while the moon is full and
so he arrives as the moon rises and leaves as it sets, and when Hallow's Eve starts on a full moon
this placement hands him over to the Hallow's Eve one. Both are the same character, since neither
writes an Identity.NpcId. Lifecycle keeps his chunk loaded, stands him up again if something
removes him, and raises his health past anything that can be dealt. Where and Anchor match the
Hallow's Eve placement; move both together.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Gravekeeper_Restless_Temple
